regime_context: The policy regime is staged stagflationary hawkishness: Warsh is banking inflation-mandate credibility while Bessent suppresses long yields structurally, so the administration buys the lower-real-yield outcome without near-term easing optics. The consensus reads the hawkish tape as a new Volcker era; revealed interest says cuts stay inflation-gated optionality, not dead — the weak-jobs leg is the only live trigger.
regime_context_zh: 政策体制是分阶段的滞胀式鹰派：沃什在积累通胀使命的公信力，而贝森特在结构上压低长端收益率，因此政府在不产生近期宽松观感的情况下获得低实际收益率的结果。市场共识把鹰派信号解读为新沃尔克时代；但揭示的利益表明，降息仍是受通胀门槛约束的期权，而非已死——疲弱的就业数据是唯一活着的触发点。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse is a realized oil-shock catalyst, and energy was already the top ETF-inflow sector on the conflict; the administration tolerates the oil spike because the haven bid gives Bessent his strong-dollar bridge without easing. Headline-fragile, but the re-escalation flow favors energy over SPY near-term.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂是已实现的油价冲击催化剂，能源此前已因冲突成为ETF资金流入最多的板块；政府容忍油价飙升，因为避险买盘给了贝森特一个无需宽松的强美元桥梁。对头条敏感，但重新升级的资金流使能源短期内相对SPY占优。
evidence: Iran/Middle East theater: ceasefire collapsed as of 7/8, Brent spiked ~$80 intraday, energy top ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026
Market state: quad Reflation, inflation_score 0.4 reflects the realized oil shock
theses.dissent: The spike is headline-fragile and two-sided: any rapid de-escalation or Hormuz transit normalization craters the premium, and XLE already front-ran the move.
theses.dissent_zh: 这次飙升对头条高度敏感且双向：任何快速降级或霍尔木兹通行正常化都会摧毁溢价，而XLE已提前反映了这轮行情。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: The Fed hike majority (>70% Sept) plus a realized oil shock re-anchors inflation expectations, and Bessent's yield suppression is front-end/bill-focused — the long end still bears the stagflation risk premium. A near-term hike or persistent hawkish forward curve hurts TLT vs SPY.
theses.thesis_zh: 美联储加息概率占多数（9月>70%）加上已实现的油价冲击重新锚定通胀预期，而贝森特的收益率抑制集中在短端/国库券——长端仍承担滞胀风险溢价。近期加息或持续鹰派的前瞻曲线会损害TLT相对SPY的表现。
evidence: Market state: CME FedWatch >70% Sept hike probability, fed_path_gap market more dovish than Fed (-14bp)
Dollar/debt theater: front-end Treasuries are the structural bid; long end is not the policy lever
theses.dissent: If the labor crack widens (June payrolls +57k, participation 61.5%), Warsh's data-driven September pivot reopens — long-duration would rally hard on the first genuine easing signal.
theses.dissent_zh: 如果就业裂口扩大（6月非农+57k，参与率61.5%），沃什以数据驱动的9月转向会重新开启——久期资产会在第一个真实的宽松信号上大涨。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: XLF
theses.thesis: Warsh's framework reset (dealer-intermediation reform, eSLR progress, Treasury central clearing) structurally favors dealer banks' balance-sheet and fee economics, and a hike-majority curve steepens front-end margins for financials. Prior XLF miss was a Goldilocks-regime artifact; the Reflation quad has a perfect 5/5 hit record in this ledger.
theses.thesis_zh: 沃什的框架重置（交易商中介改革、eSLR进展、国债中央清算）结构上有利于交易商银行的资产负债表和费用经济，而加息占多数的曲线加宽了金融股的前端利差。此前的XLF失误是金发姑娘环境的产物；再通胀象限在本账本中有5/5的完美命中记录。
evidence: Dollar/debt theater: dealer-intermediation reform, eSLR-reform progress, SEC central-clearing expansion as policy levers
Track record: Reflation regime 5/5 hits, dir_accuracy 0.8 — XLF prior miss was in Goldilocks
theses.dissent: A BIS-style dealer-intermediation squeeze or a government-driven Treasury clearing push could compress dealer margins instead of expanding them, and a dovish September pivot flattens the curve against financials.
theses.dissent_zh: BIS式的交易商中介挤压或政府推动的国债清算扩张可能压缩而非扩大交易商利润，而9月鸽派转向会使曲线走平，不利于金融股。

falsifier.text: XLF lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date
